invariants: A share class is issuer-side identity and survives changes in holders and positions.

Economic, capital, voting, conversion and priority rights remain distinct.
Economic interest never implies voting control, consolidation or signing authority.
Comparisons use a common class, right type, denominator and effective period.
Treasury and suspended holdings follow explicit denominator and voting rules.
Class amendments append effective-dated versions and never rewrite prior rights.
A class designation is unique only within its issuer and never supplies global identity.
Corporate-action authority cites an effective mandate and authentic record.
Cross-holding calculations declare method, tolerance, scenario, rule version and inputs.
Derived percentages remain labelled and separate from asserted positions.
Class cancellation preserves historical holdings, rights and issued instruments.
